shards.why_serial: UNVERIFIED since WORKER_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECONDS=1 landed. The original reason -- 'worker-subprocess coverage files race under xdist' -- cannot happen by filename: .coveragerc sets parallel=true and relative_files=true, so every process writes .coverage.<host>.<pid>.<rand>. Flipping to 2 needs three measured runs agreeing to within 0.2 coverage points, not this reasoning; ~150s of shard time is at stake.
